title: Very misleading subscription model, borderline a scam!
body: This app is highly misleading and borderline a scam. In the sign up process online, you’re asked to fill out a lengthy questionnaire, in order to get your results you’re asked for a very small payment of around 1$. You then download the app which it requires you to do in order to view your results. Nowhere in the apple subscription page does it register that you are in fact signed up for a subscription. After a month of not knowing, they charge around $47 from your account to renew. They make it very difficult to view your subscription status within the app, every time you want to view it you have to log in, and then when you choose to cancel it, it takes you through multiple “are you sure” pages, the last one even trying to get you to download a new app. Looking at the other reviews here it seems like many others were trapped into this subscription.

title: What happened?
body:
I started using this app when it was fairly new...about 5 years ago. I loved it. There's nothing I didn't like about it. But I noticed a few things.

I've had a few unfortunate phone incidents over the past year and realised with sadness that Fabulous doesn't let you keep your data when you log in with your details again. You have to start all over again. Fabulous had tuis "lucky" package for people who innitially joined when they didn't have many fans yet. I lost all that since you start over again if you reinstall this app to your new phone. Obviously done with intention to get you to pay.

Fabulous became increasingly money greedy. Every single "extra" feature is a ploy to get you to join for one week "free" then after its only "this many bucks a year". You can cancel any time you wish. However they know many users forget to cancel on time. I hate it so much, because I knew Fabulous at its inception. It wasn't like this. Not at all. 

What drew me to Fabulous app was how special it made you feel in your attempt to better yourself. It was personal and felt especially made for you. It's was very user friendly and fun to use & add new habits to complete. It's beautifully designed and clear that it was created by a team of great people.

Now though? I'm thinking of uninstalling for for good. There were many features that is not there anymore. Or is it because I'm not a premium user? What happened to the challenges you could join for free with other people? "No sugar for a week", "No social media for a week", etc. 

Fabulous was in the business of helping people. Unfortunately it is now in the business of making money.
